title: GLP-1 trials on ClinicalTrials.gov that register a biological-age or aging-clock outcome
method: Pulled every study listing semaglutide, tirzepatide or retatrutide as an intervention. Flagged any whose title, summary or registered outcomes mention biological age, aging clocks, epigenetic or methylation age, named clocks (GrimAge, PhenoAge, DunedinPACE, Horvath, Hannum), proteomic or organ age, age acceleration, healthspan, longevity, geroscience, senescence or telomeres. Read each hit by hand; kept studies whose registered outcomes include a biological-age clock. A second, looser pass (any outcome mentioning aging, methylation, clock, frailty, telomere, senescence, klotho or epigenetics) found no additional clock outcomes. Registry text only: post hoc analyses (such as Novo's and Lilly's) do not appear unless registered.

summary.query: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, query.intr = semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide (all statuses)
